A specialist business considering succession

Business continuity can involve more possibilities than a domestic search reveals.

The situation

The owner of a Japanese specialist manufacturer wants to explore succession. An Indian business could potentially value its know-how and customer relationships, but commercial fit and continuity need careful examination.

How SetuHashi could help

Assess continuity options, identify potential successors or partners and coordinate transition planning with transaction, legal and tax specialists.

What the assignment could produce

An options assessment, qualified candidates with stated interest and a proposed transition plan.

The intended value

A wider, better-understood set of choices for the owner and a considered approach to preserving business value.

Related services

  • Plan for succession and renewal
  • Find and develop suitable partnerships
